title: A gym's sales offers pop up on the same notification line as its messages and replies
what: The server sends a gym's new offers to members' phones on the same Android notification line it uses for the gym's messages, a trainer's reply and the member's own notes. Phone settings let a member silence a line, not one kind of pop-up, so a member who wants no sales offers must also lose replies and notes from the gym. Google asks that promotional pop-ups can be switched off on their own.
expected: Offers arrive on their own notification line (for example 'Offers from your gym'), so a member can silence offers and still get messages and replies.
fix_line: Send offers on a separate offers notification line that the member app creates

items.reason: Payments here are gym owners buying MettleUp outside the Play app (web payment link, test keys only), so Play billing is not involved. WhatsApp plan-end reminders are a stub that sends nothing until Meta approves a template. The gate Worker is not deployed and touches no store. Offers share the messages notification line (finding). The Play data safety form itself is not in the inputs, so whether it lists push addresses and the read log was not compared.
These Workers have no store listing and no iPhone app; web pop-ups already accept Apple's push address.
The workers ship only MettleUp's own HQ icons and a local stylesheet; no outside fonts, pictures, music or voices. No own package list here; open-source notice gaps are already logged for the apps.
